extra.final_summary: The data had three issues affecting the question: 1) Category labels had extra spaces (e.g., ' Accessories', ' Office Supplies') which were normalized to valid labels; 2) Two rows had negative Quantity values (-4, -5), which violate the rule that Quantity must be at least 1 (positive units sold), so those rows were excluded; 3) The Price column contained dollar amounts as text (e.g., '$12.00'), which were converted to numbers. After fixes, the analysis shows: East sold 84 units, North sold 75 units, South sold 101 units, and West sold 79 units.
